name: Team Bulbasaur: Grass Momentum & Special Walls
archetype: Special Grass/Flying starter aerial pivot, Intimidate dragon dance sweepers, and colossal Special walls.
gym_duel_rationale: Sabrina commands high-velocity Special Psychic attackers. Enter her 4v4 arena with Snorlax (colossal 160 HP and 110 SpD that shrugs off Psychic assaults and dismantles foes with Body Slam and Bite), Gyarados/Arbok (Intimidate Water/Poison breaker carrying Dragon Dance, STAB Aqua Tail, and super-effective Crunch), Alakazam/Weezing (495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA firing STAB Psychic and Sludge Bomb while ignoring Ground moves), and Venusaur/Fearow (Grass/Flying aerial anchor carrying Sleep Powder to neutralize Sabrina's setup and STAB Drill Peck/Petal Dance).

roster.progression_notes: 500 BST aerial titan with 93 Speed. Resists Grass and Fighting, completely immune to Ground. Sleep Powder puts Sabrina's fast leads to sleep while Petal Dance shreds Alakazam/Slowbro.
513 BST Intimidate bruiser with 110 Attack. Resists Water, Fairy, and Poison. Sets up Dragon Dance and tears through Sabrina's Psychic core with super-effective Crunch.
540 BST legendary wall with 160 HP and 110 SpD. Thick Fat halves Fire and Ice damage. Amnesia boosts SpD into impenetrable territory while Body Slam paralyzes fast psychic sweepers.

roster.status: Active in Party (Evolved with Linking Cord)
roster.progression_notes: 495 BST special juggernaut with 118 SpA and 98 Speed. Levitate grants Ground immunity. Sets up Calm Mind and recovers damage while firing high-powered STAB Psychic.

roster.status: Active in Party (Honedge evolved at Lv. 35)
roster.progression_notes: 477 BST fortress with 120 Defense and 100 Attack. Quad-resists Poison and resists 8 other types. Shadow Sneak provides vital Ghost priority while Iron Head punishes Fairy types.
527 BST offensive juggernaut with 107 Attack and 95 Speed. Extreme Speed offers +2 priority revenge killing, and Crunch provides reliable Dark coverage against Psychic types.

flex_bench.progression_notes: 535 BST tank with 130 HP. Free gift from Silph Co. Ice Beam provides devastating anti-Dragon and anti-Flying artillery.
455 BST martial artist with 105 Attack. Iron Fist powers up all elemental punches, granting versatile super-effective coverage against every gym.
